scope: Node Canvas command recording and actual-engine direct-damage fixture. Not pixel/browser, natural gameplay, complete motion, global occlusion, production integration, FPS or public acceptance.

tests.name: exact scheduled binding replaces only its body/bar numeric slots, same-position controls unchanged
stage/frozen identity/exact object/current-render guards retain original buffers
mismatched slot count/null break/invalid geometry fail without partial writes
512 cap can end at target body without appending its missing bar
missing/invalid render tokens and nonwritable target slots fail before any write
actual damage number retains content/style/TTL while existing renderer chooses a finite clear candidate

cachePolicy: External current-render WeakMap; geometry from actual draw; no resample, stale geometry or entity references in numeric renderer buffer.
